name: Abunai!
blurb: The Netherlands' cheekiest anime convention at NH Koningshof in Veldhoven, with matsuri, cosplay, music and gaming.
notes: The homepage explicitly reads '2027 DATE TO BE ANNOUNCED' for the next (23rd) edition, 'Izakaya Nights', so editions is empty. The 22nd edition ('Case Closed', Aug 7-9 2026) already happened; its dates come from a web search (animecons.ca/fancons.com/rostercon.com listings) since the current homepage only shows post-event hotel/ticket announcement posts dated earlier in 2026, not the show dates themselves. Venue (NH Koningshof, Locht 117, Veldhoven) confirmed directly from the site's own schedule page.
